title: Shared Mirror adapter basis for composable image-latent controls

prior_art.fact: T2I-Adapter provides lightweight condition-specific adapters for a frozen text-to-image backbone and supports composition of multiple condition adapters.
prior_art.mirror_question: Can a shared physical linear adapter with a small Mirror coordinate recover multiple logical control adapters and additive compositions with fewer actual bytes than independent adapters while beating an equal-size plain basis mixture?

scope: CPU synthetic image-latent adapter mechanism screen; no pretrained diffusion model or images are used.

teacher.aligned_world: One random shared 8x8 adapter matrix P; each control delta is R(alpha_i)P, where R applies four fixed disjoint output-plane Givens rotations with control-specific angle alpha_i sampled from world seed.
teacher.independent_world: Four independent random full-rank 8x8 control matrices sampled from world seed.
teacher.composition: Two-control target is the sum of its two component control deltas applied to the same latent feature x. No interaction term is added.
teacher.data: x is iid standard normal; separate deterministic train/dev/single-audit/composition-audit streams. Train only single controls; evaluate all singles and all six held-out control pairs.

methods.independent_adapters: Four free 8x8 matrices; strongest independent adapter reference.
methods.mirror_givens: One shared 8x8 matrix plus one learned scalar angle per control applied through four fixed Givens planes (68 parameters).
methods.basis_mix2: Two unrestricted shared 8x8 adapter basis matrices and two learned coefficients per control (136 parameters); generic basis synthesis control.
methods.film_controls: One shared 8x8 adapter matrix with per-control learned output-channel scale and bias.
methods.hard_shared: One common 8x8 adapter matrix for all controls, no per-control coordinate.

training.checkpoint_selection: Lowest average single-control development MSE; evaluate every 25 updates; choose a method-specific update count pooled across development worlds and model seeds.
training.fresh_rule: Freeze update counts before opening audit single/composition query samples.

secondary: composition error vs sum of component predictions
metrics.storage: Safetensors packed inference state per method/world/init; include all bases, codes, matrices, and schema/layout metadata in measured file bytes.

success_gate: In aligned worlds, Mirror pair-composition MSE <=1.10x independent-adapter MSE in at least 2/3 audit worlds, and total serialized adapter payload <=60% of independent adapters. Report basis_mix2 on its quality/bytes frontier. Mirror-specific value requires a quality/bytes benefit over basis_mix2, not mere equivalence.
failure_gate: FAIL if aligned composition quality or storage gate fails in at least 2/3 valid audit worlds, or basis_mix2 matches quality and is no worse in bytes/latency. Off-orbit independent matrices are a boundary test, not a required pass.
boundaries: Synthetic fixed-feature linear adapter mechanism, not a diffusion model or T2I-Adapter reproduction.
Aligned teacher is constructed from Givens transforms and favors Mirror.
No image quality, text alignment, prompt controllability, or production runtime claim.
